rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for trying to find or look for something.

example.english: I want to seek out a job near home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 wan2 fan6 gan6 uk1 kei2 ge3 gung1

rows.note: Use this before an action when you mean to try or attempt to do it.

example.english: Try to seek help from the shop assistant.
example.jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 man6 haa5 go3 dim3 jyun4 laa1

rows.note: Use this when asking for something such as forgiveness, help, or a favor.

example.jyutping: ngo5 kau4 nei5 jyun4 loeng6 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when actively striving to obtain or gain something.

example.english: We must seek to win this contract.
example.traditional: 我哋要爭取攞到呢份合約。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaang1 ceoi2 lo2 dou2 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3
